title: FTSE 100 LIVE: Stocks surge after Trump says Iran war could end 'very soon'
title_zh: 富时100实时：特朗普表示伊朗战争可能“很快”结束后股市飙升
summary: Stocks jumped on Tuesday morning, after the US president said that the war with Iran was 'very complete'
summary_zh: 在美国总统表示与伊朗的战争“非常完整”后，股市周二上午上涨

title: TSMC Sales Grow 30% on Sustained Global Demand for AI Hardware
title_zh: 全球人工智能硬件需求持续增长，台积电销售额增长 30%
summary: The go-to chipmaker for Nvidia Corp., Advanced Micro Devices Inc. and Broadcom Inc. serves as a barometer for the global AI industry, with attention now on how the US and Israel’s strike on Iran will affect appetite to build data centers and other digital infrastructure.
summary_zh: 这家 Nvidia 公司、Advanced Micro Devices Inc. 和 Broadcom Inc. 的首选芯片制造商是全球人工智能行业的晴雨表，目前人们的注意力集中在美国和以色列对伊朗的打击将如何影响建设数据中心和其他数字基础设施的兴趣。

title: European freight truck makers brace for wave of low-cost Chinese rivals
title_zh: 欧洲货运卡车制造商准备迎接低成本中国竞争对手的浪潮
summary: ANTWERP/SODERTALJE, Sweden, March 10 (Reuters) - Chinese electric freight trucks are rolling into Europe at pace this year, following the trail blazed by Chinese EVs and threatening to upend the
summary_zh: 瑞典安特卫普/索德泰利耶，3 月 10 日（路透社）——继中国电动汽车开辟的道路之后，中国电动货运卡车今年正大举进军欧洲，并有可能颠覆欧洲市场。

title: Ex-Meta AI chief Yann LeCun's AMI raises $1.03 billion for alternative AI approach
title_zh: 前 Meta AI 首席执行官 Yann LeCun 的 AMI 为替代人工智能方法筹集了 10.3 亿美元
summary: Advanced Machine Intelligence, the startup founded by former Meta Platforms chief AI scientist Yann LeCun, said on Tuesday it ‌raised $1.03 billion based on a $3.50 billion pre-money valuation, as it seeks ‌to commercialize artificial intelligence systems built around reasonin...
summary_zh: 由前 Meta Platforms 首席人工智能科学家 Yann LeCun 创立的初创公司 Advanced Machine Intelligence 周二表示，根据 35 亿美元的投前估值，筹集了 10.3 亿美元，因为该公司寻求将围绕推理构建的人工智能系统商业化。

title: Apple Now Makes About 25% of iPhones in India After China Pivot
title_zh: 重心转向中国后，苹果现在约 25% 的 iPhone 在印度生产
summary: The company assembled about 55 million iPhones in India in 2025, up from 36 million a year earlier, people familiar with the matter said, asking not to be named because the numbers aren’t public.
summary_zh: 知情人士称，2025 年该公司在印度组装了约 5500 万部 iPhone，高于一年前的 3600 万部。由于数字未公开，知情人士要求不具名。

title: German publishers reject Apple's revised app tracking rules, urge antitrust fine
title_zh: 德国出版商拒绝苹果修订后的应用程序跟踪规则，敦促反垄断罚款
summary: German publishers and advertisers on Tuesday called for the country's competition authority to fine Apple over proposed changes to its app tracking ‌rules, saying they do not do enough to resolve antitrust issues.
summary_zh: 德国出版商和广告商周二呼吁该国竞争主管机构就苹果修改其应用程序跟踪规则的提议进行罚款，称他们在解决反垄断问题方面做得不够。

title: Wall Street ends higher as Trump signals Iran war resolution
title_zh: 特朗普暗示伊朗战争解决方案，华尔街收高
summary: STORY: Wall Street stocks clawed their way back from a steep selloff to close higher on Monday, notching a final-hour rebound as U.S.
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街股市周一从大幅抛售中奋力反弹，收高收盘，随着美国股市的上涨，在最后一个小时出现反弹。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise, oil slides after volatile day on Wall Street
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货上涨，华尔街动荡一天后油价下跌
summary: Wall Street is adjusting to a historic spike and fall in oil prices after the global economy was thrown into disarray.
summary_zh: 全球经济陷入混乱后，华尔街正在适应油价历史性的上涨和下跌。

title: 'Make Tech Value Again': This is software's 'only hope'
title_zh: “再次让技术价值”：这是软件的“唯一希望”
summary: Portfolio Wealth Advisors president and chief investment officer Lee Munson chats with Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre on the New York Stock Exchange floor to discuss the market's (^DJI, ^GSPC, ^IXIC) reaction to the Iran war, volatility (^VIX), and more.
summary_zh: Portfolio Wealth Advisors 总裁兼首席投资官 Lee Munson 在纽约证券交易所与雅虎金融市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 交谈，讨论市场 (^DJI、^GSPC、^IXIC) 对伊朗战争、波动性 (^VIX) 等的反应。
